questions.q: Which device connects different networks together and directs packets to their destination?
questions.why: A router connects networks and forwards packets using IP addresses. A switch only connects devices within one LAN.

options: Translates a domain name into an IP address
questions.why: The domain name system translates domain names such as www.example.com into IP addresses.

questions.q: Which protocol is used to send an email from a client to a mail server?
questions.why: SMTP sends email. POP3 and IMAP are used to receive or access email.

questions.q: Describe one advantage and one disadvantage of a star topology.
questions.model: Advantage: each device has its own cable to the central switch, so a cable failure affects only that device and devices are easy to add. Disadvantage: if the central switch fails, the whole network stops working.
points: advantage: failure of one cable only affects one device / easy to add devices / good performance
disadvantage: central switch is a single point of failure / needs more cable
